Photorealistic PBR diffuse/albedo texture photograph, direct perpendicular overhead orthographic capture of an ANCIENT HAND-LAID DUNGEON FLAGSTONE FLOOR, square 1:1 seamless material field. Entire image is stone paving, no other objects. Medium-scale field roughly six meters square, containing about 14 to 16 paving slabs across, irregular large polygonal and rectangular limestone/granite slabs individually fitted by hand, some half-size inset stones, natural variation of shape and size. Broad flat softly abraded slab interiors with subtle cloudy mineral coloration and fine low-contrast stone pores; quiet readable middle of image. Natural worn chipped rims, shallow rounded edge breaks, narrow recessed mortar earth joints, a few tiny joint pockets of dark desaturated moss and damp soil toward perimeter. Restrained uneven aging along edges, gentle traffic smoothing nearer center, no clean geometric border or obvious vignette.

Material palette muted medium slate gray, gray-brown, restrained warm gray and occasional cooler gray slabs, only slight olive staining in selected joints. Match sophisticated realistic dark-fantasy dungeon environment art, not polished interior stone. Preserve mid-value visibility under game lighting, subtle stone-by-stone tones. A few small light worn patches on high spots. Delicate mortar occlusion is sufficient; NO baked directional shadows, torch lighting or specular shine. Flat neutral diffuse capture.

Keep rich realism and wear but calm broad slab surfaces at game scale. A production-ready flat floor texture, not an angled scene or close-up of three enormous rocks.
